fallbackBody: Open the app to see it.

credential_counter_regression.title: Security check needed
credential_counter_regression.body: A passkey reported an unexpected sign-in count. Check your passkeys and remove any you don't recognise.

push_job_stuck.title: Notification delivery stuck
push_job_stuck.body: A notification stopped sending for 10 minutes and was marked failed. Check the notification jobs.

super_passkey_added.title: New passkey on a Super Admin account
super_passkey_added.body: A passkey was just added to a Super Admin account. If this wasn't you, remove it in Account now.

payment_request.title: UPI change requested
payment_request.body: A masjid asked to change its UPI payment details. Review it in Payment approvals.

payment_request_owner.title: UPI change asked for your masjid
payment_request_owner.body: An owner of your masjid asked to change its UPI details. If you don't know about it, tell the Super Admin now.

payment_approved.title: UPI change approved
payment_approved.body: A UPI change for your masjid was approved. It goes live after the waiting period. If you didn't ask for it, tell the Super Admin now.

payment_rejected.title: UPI change not approved
payment_rejected.body: Your UPI change was not approved. Open Payment to see why.

payment_active.title: New UPI details are live
payment_active.body: Your masjid's new UPI details are now shown to everyone, and followers were told. If you didn't ask for this, tell the Super Admin now.

report_urgent.title: Urgent report
report_urgent.body: A post or masjid was reported for personal or private information. Review it in Reports within 2 hours.

report_autohide.title: Post hidden after many reports
report_autohide.body: A post was hidden automatically because many people reported it. Review it in Reports.

item_removed.title: A post was removed
item_removed.body: A post from your masjid was removed by the app team. Open My Posts to see the reason.

sla_50.title: Half the time has passed
sla_50.body: Something in Reports has used half of the time allowed to handle it. Open the dashboard.

sla_80.title: Deadline is close
sla_80.body: Something in Reports must be handled soon — most of its time has passed. Open the dashboard.

sla_100.title: Deadline passed
sla_100.body: Something in Reports is past its deadline. Handle it now from the dashboard.

retention_failed.title: Retention run failed
retention_failed.body: The daily clean-up could not finish. It will try again; see the audit log.
